decisions.decision: Use a 5x2 trunk matrix on wide screens and a linear stack on phones
decisions.reason: Ten verified trunk nodes remain visible without horizontal scrolling.

decisions.decision: Use shared generated HTML and one CSS system
decisions.reason: New disciplines inherit the same visual contract without duplicated templates.

decisions.decision: Exclude unverified and draft nodes from publication
decisions.reason: Source confidence is a publishing gate, not a visual badge.
